lucyRobotics.title: Lucy-Robotics
lucyRobotics.p1: The association behind Lucy, an open-source robotics framework that makes robots simpler to use. One platform, any robot: a single ROS 2 core between the robots and the interfaces that drive them.
lucyRobotics.p2: Lucy supports InMoov (the open-source humanoid by Gaël Langevin) and the SO-101 arm today, and new robots and interfaces join as the community grows. Software is licensed under GPL-3.0; hardware contributions follow InMoov's CC BY-NC licence.
lucyRobotics.lucyDesc: ROS 2 core (lucy_ros_packages, lucy_embedded_firmware) packaged in lucy_ws, with the Lucy Control Panel and a CLI as interfaces.
lucyRobotics.huriDesc: AI framework for speech-to-speech, multi-layer memory and kinematic grounding.
